entries.en: Man, this place is crawlin' with Shadows[n]like always.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Right, but they won't notice us from[n]where we are now. This is a great[n]infiltration point!
It's thanks to Panther.
This is useful.
Let's keep going.

entries.en: Huh? Oh right, that's me!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hm... I'm still not really used to that[n]name...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Either way, it's prolly good we got a[n]hang of this place's layout when we[n]came in here before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: True. We might be able to get to some[n]places we haven't checked yet from here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Either way, it's prolly good we got a[n]hang of this place's layout when we[n]came in here before.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Mm-hm.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: As I said before, we need to find the[n]Treasure as well as secure a route to[n]its location.

entries.en: It's not like you would understand if I[n]tried to teach you everything at once.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I guess that's true... Hold on, it[n]feels like you're makin' fun of me for[n]some reason...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Anyway, let's just keep doing what[n]Mona tells us.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
